title: What prevents the poor from reaching the middle class?  | VISION TALKS
summary: Megan McArdle's AEI Vision Talk 'Capital and Poverty' argues that social and financial capital work differently in low-income communities, and that this explains barriers to reaching the middle class.
why: Cited to explain why poor people's seemingly irrational financial decisions can rationally protect their social safety net.

quote.text: poor people make seemingly dumb decisions because if they don't help their social network when it comes knocking
